source.title: Atlas des champignons comestibles et vénéneux (Planche 54)

modifications: Selected two separate specimen studies from Plate 54.
Removed the historical species, edibility, and toxicity labels by excluding them or painting only background regions white.
Converted to monochrome, set black and white points, recomposed with a visible white gutter, stripped metadata, and encoded as opaque lossless WebP.
